C30.title_zh: 生成关系的解释必要性
C30.claim_zh: 独立指定的取得、错误与后续问题要求保留实际差异和共同边界；接合探针进一步恢复有限片段接口，三元关系唯一确定局部单位，完整有限轨迹恢复其状态接口。整体表述仍合格，容量反例限定接口匹配的充分性。 最新从原有机制直接证明摘要充分性，推出有效规律与全部有限历史精确对应，不另给Exact或同态前提。 普遍化检验给出任意三元关系恢复的充要条件；完整成功答案与最少状态／边仍允许不同构机制，确定且可达、后续可区分时恢复唯一对应。 后续以共同条件下的复合接续问题推出有限分支双模拟，并由准确约简答案构造可从每个相容原生起点提升的编码规律；结构唯一性不再要求确定性。 再以后继紧致性放宽有限分支，取得结构对应及完整无限编码路径提升；有无限多个可区分后继的正例，也有全部有限复合答案相同而无限持续不同的反例。 共同问题再在明示成对紧致性下迫出步骤／接合对应并提升有限逐节点方案；实际占用／释放推出共享冲突。全部孤立共同问题仍可能遗漏指定部分的共享身份，固定搭配问题在有限实例中恢复。
C30.claim_en: Independently specified acquisition, error and continuation questions require native distinctions and shared boundaries. Joining probes further recover finite-fragment interfaces; the ternary relation determines unique unit roles, and complete finite traces recover their state interfaces. Global accounts remain eligible; capacity limits matching-unit sufficiency. The latest concrete summary-sufficiency proof derives an effective law and exact finite-history correspondence from the unchanged mechanism, without a separate Exact or homomorphism premise. The universal attempt characterizes arbitrary ternary-relation recovery: complete success answers and minimum states/edges still allow nonisomorphic mechanisms; deterministic reachable continuation-separated realizations recover uniqueness. The continuation derives finite-branch bisimulation from compound questions at shared conditions and reconstructs code histories lifting from every compatible native start; scoped structural uniqueness no longer requires determinism. Successor compactness further replaces finite branching, preserving structural correspondence and lifting whole infinite code runs; a genuinely infinitely branching positive model contrasts with equal finite-modal answers but different infinite realization. Joint questions further force step/joint correspondence under explicit correlated-pair compactness and lift finite nodewise plans; acquisition/release derives shared-support conflict. Complete isolated joint profiles can still lose designated-part aliasing, recovered by fixed-partner questions in the finite witness.

C30.scope_en: Earlier studies, including native unfolding (42 theorems / 64 new audits and its independent review), retain their scopes. This separate 54 (23+31) / 128 audit study has 105 empty and 23 propext-only lists. Probe access, state content and completion are explicit; identification with shared-capacity/concurrent conflicts remains open. New 14 theorems / 18 empty audits; 192 inherited maps unchanged (150 empty, 42 standard), independently reviewed. Existing controller/oxygen evidence is integrated without equating those cases with this construction or completing universal grounding. Overlapping imports are not added. This separate round adds 61 theorems / 135 audits (123 empty, 12 inherited propext; all new 61 empty). Existing effective-law results remain credited. Universal separation of native relations remains unwarranted; the scoped counterexample does not globally refute the conjecture. This round: 45 new theorems / 141 audits, 103 empty and 38 standard; new 19 empty and 26 standard, including 13 with classical choice. Finite branching, question coverage and reduction/separation are explicit; forward adequacy does not recover every actual past or prove universal explanatory scope. This round adds 36 theorems / 159 audits (102 empty, 57 standard; new 5 empty, 31 standard). Successor compactness is an explicit sufficient condition, not a universal law or finite-observation inference; whole continuation, actual history and general joint realization retain distinct scopes. This round adds 56 theorems / 183 audits (112 empty, 71 standard; new 6 empty, 50 standard). Pair compactness, question coverage and separation are explicit; nodewise joint plans do not establish arbitrary substitution or global concurrency, and universal uniqueness remains unproved.

F22.claim_zh: 继承校准、结构对手、组合唯一性及实际展开的接合／替换、分支继续与同规律错误反例；另增空历史探针、局部单位唯一性与关系同构下保持、完整接续充要条件和整个状态接口恢复。容量及内部序列丢失反例保留。 最新从原有机制直接证明摘要充分性，推出有效规律与全部有限历史精确对应，不另给Exact或同态前提。 普遍化检验给出任意三元关系恢复的充要条件；完整成功答案与最少状态／边仍允许不同构机制，确定且可达、后续可区分时恢复唯一对应。 后续以共同条件下的复合接续问题推出有限分支双模拟，并由准确约简答案构造可从每个相容原生起点提升的编码规律；结构唯一性不再要求确定性。 再以后继紧致性放宽有限分支，取得结构对应及完整无限编码路径提升；有无限多个可区分后继的正例，也有全部有限复合答案相同而无限持续不同的反例。 共同问题再在明示成对紧致性下迫出步骤／接合对应并提升有限逐节点方案；实际占用／释放推出共享冲突。全部孤立共同问题仍可能遗漏指定部分的共享身份，固定搭配问题在有限实例中恢复。 再以完整下层支持覆盖及同级独占支持分离，将任意有限方案接到全局无重复与一次共同占用历史；遗漏关系的失败及修复正例均检查。每个固定 n 阶成功清单仍可漏掉 n+1 阶共享容量限制。
F22.claim_en: Retains calibration, structural rivals, compositional uniqueness and native unfolding’s joining/substitution, branch-continuation distinctions and same-law error cases. Adds empty-history probes, unique units and transport, an exact completion criterion and state-interface recovery, retaining capacity and internal-word-loss counters. The latest concrete summary-sufficiency proof derives an effective law and exact finite-history correspondence from the unchanged mechanism, without a separate Exact or homomorphism premise. The universal attempt characterizes arbitrary ternary-relation recovery: complete success answers and minimum states/edges still allow nonisomorphic mechanisms; deterministic reachable continuation-separated realizations recover uniqueness. The continuation derives finite-branch bisimulation from compound questions at shared conditions and reconstructs code histories lifting from every compatible native start; scoped structural uniqueness no longer requires determinism. Successor compactness further replaces finite branching, preserving structural correspondence and lifting whole infinite code runs; a genuinely infinitely branching positive model contrasts with equal finite-modal answers but different infinite realization. Joint questions further force step/joint correspondence under explicit correlated-pair compactness and lift finite nodewise plans; acquisition/release derives shared-support conflict. Complete isolated joint profiles can still lose designated-part aliasing, recovered by fixed-partner questions in the finite witness. Complete descendant support and sibling exclusion further connect arbitrary finite plans to distinct global requests and a common holding history; omission failures and a positive repair are checked. Every fixed n-ary success list can still miss an (n+1)-ary capacity restriction.

Recovery is not acquisition or unique grounding. New 14 theorems / 18 empty audits; 192 inherited maps unchanged (150 empty, 42 standard), independently reviewed. Existing controller/oxygen evidence is integrated without equating those cases with this construction or completing universal grounding. Overlapping imports are not added. owned_continuations.appended_text:
## 65. 各节点接合与整套方案实现之间

上一轮的有限方案定理保证每个节点都有相容见证，却没有保证所有叶子需要的支持能同时保留。本轮先固定一个可检验的目标：各项指定请求通过取得支持，在同一个终点仍全部占用它们，中途不释放。这比各自曾经成功更强，但仍不是一般并发执行或永久共同持续。

支持、活动和占用是同一配置中的不同关系。支持独占、接入固定及取得后保留，是本轮局部规律；没有将独立主体与外部资源作为本体起点，也没有把所有共同实现先限定为资源分割。

## 66. 完整支持范围怎样使局部证明组成整体

给每个部分一个支持范围，要求其覆盖所接合子部分的支持；另要求同级部分不共享需要独占的位置。叶子请求保留为列表，不把重复请求通过集合化抹掉。

Lean 已证明，这两个针对单次接合的条件，足以对任意有限嵌套方案推出：全部叶子请求都在整体范围内，而且没有位置被重复请求。关键是把下层需求逐层带到分支交汇处，才有根据把同级的局部分离用于整个子方案。

在具体的列表支持模型中，还证明了逆向：请求无重复且属于整体范围，就能构造每个中间节点的正确证书。该模型的方案可重新分组或排列而保留可行性。这些是本模型的推论，不把先前泛型接合关系无条件宣布为可结合、可交换。

## 67. 从支持证书接到共同占用历史

新取得规律要求位置可接入、当前未占用，随后加入占用记录。完整轨迹的充要条件已经检查：请求无重复、全部可接入且最初空闲，终点等于原占用记录加上全部请求。已有占用不会在过程中被悄悄释放。

由此，具体支持方案与一次共同占用历史精确相连；任意编码方案也可经上一轮的准确约简编码、成对紧致性与逐代表提升，在附加支持规律和正确叶子解释下得到这种历史。经典选择仅在继承的任意编码连接中出现，直接支持组合与取得轨迹不需要它。

这里构造的是已明示的取得过程，不是自动证明任意模型原来的事件关系都实现了它。实际应用须说明接入、取得与保留的对应。取得可以先后发生，终点占用共同存在；持续执行中相互改变条件、调度及支持生成，还需要更丰富的过程说明。

## 68. 跨分支冲突的反例与修复

一棵方案树的三个叶子请求位置0、1、0。若左边中间节点只报空支持，它与右边的位置0看似不冲突；左边内部的0与1也不冲突。因此全部直接同级检查都通过，却没有一次取得历史能重复独占位置0。

反例明确指出遗漏：中间描述没有保留下层实际需要的支持。相反，只保留包含关系、不检查同级冲突，也可以错误接纳两个都请求位置0的部分。加入两个条件后的接合关系排除失败方案，并接纳0、1、2三个不同支持的方案及成功轨迹。

这说明较弱证书遗漏了关系，不反驳已经包含完整关系的解释。支持范围如果是过宽估计，相交本身也不证明实际请求冲突。真实形成新支持可以改变范围；本轮没有把固定范围的包含法则当作生成现实的普遍规律。

## 69. 任意固定阶数的成功清单都可能不够

独占支持不是唯一共同实现形式。另一个已检查的过程具有共享容量，每取得一项活动就把共同负载增加一，到容量上限后不能继续取得，中途不释放。

容量2与容量3的安排，对全部单项及两项取得请求都回答成功；三项请求却只有后者成功。更一般地，Lean 对任意自然数 n 证明：容量 n 与 n+1 的安排都接纳每个不超过 n 项的请求，但 n+1 项区分两者。

保持相同的是限定阶数的接纳答案，不是完整内部规律或全部嵌套问题。已知容量规律能以有限说明覆盖所有规模。因此结论不是必须无限实验，而是不能从固定阶数的成功答案独自推出任意规模的共同实现；还须保留总需求与实际共同限制的关系。

## 70. 对解释必要性与唯一性的进一步定位

可以更准确地说：解释若承诺整体共同实现，就必须保留足以判断实际共同需求的关系；局部摘要必须在组成时保留这些内容。正确支持范围和共享容量规律给出两种已检查的实现方式。整体不等于把各部分成功相加，生成关系也不能只理解成彼此独立的二元连线。

静态整体约束、分配规则或过程规律都可以保留同样内容。本轮不排除这些表述，也不证明当前术语或独占支持本体的普遍唯一性。固定接入、持续占用条件下的局部到整体桥梁已完成；尚需推进的是实际历史改变支持及共同条件时，描述如何保持充分。以前已完成的顺序释放再用不重开。

本轮37项新定理为4项空依赖、3项仅propext、28项另含Quot.sound、2项再含Classical.choice；147项继承审计保持原范围，完整184项为115空、69标准。没有自定公理或证明缺口；已知分离逻辑路线明确署名。[完整整合](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/EXPLANATORY-GLOBAL-REALIZATION-INTEGRATION.md)记录实际对应、反例、充分条件及作者反审。

**English current summary.** Descendant-covering footprints and local exclusion of shared exclusive support imply distinct global requests for arbitrary finite plans. A complete footprint criterion is equivalent to an admitted acquisition history with common final holding under a fixed-access, no-release law. Missing containment or separation yields checked counterexamples. A shared-capacity family agrees on all admission questions up to each fixed arity n but differs at n+1. Operational correspondence and unrestricted target coverage remain substantive; universal ontological uniqueness and general dynamic concurrency are not claimed.

## 继续跨分支检验 / Continue the cross-branch test

Ren 在共同实现、共享支持与情境身份结果之后继续指示：

> 继续

AI 执行范围：沿同一解释必要性研究，检验逐节点共同方案与全局共同实现之间的连接，形式化完整支持范围、跨分支冲突、实际取得历史及固定阶数共同问题的容量边界。[本轮整合](../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/EXPLANATORY-GLOBAL-REALIZATION-INTEGRATION.md)中的数学结论和哲学阐释是 AI 的研究产物，不作为 Ren 的原话。未授权或创建新会话、独立 agent、定时任务或对外消息；已完成伦理路线保持原范围。
